name: OR-06
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by about six points on the partisan baseline
Salinas is an incumbent with a large fundraising edge ($1.6M vs. $13K)
Prediction markets price Democratic win around 96%
No public polling or expert ratings available
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Salinas: a Democratic-leaning district, incumbency, and an overwhelming money advantage over a barely funded challenger, with markets pricing a Democratic win near certain. With no polling to contradict that picture, the forecast stays close to the fundamentals-based margin.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a much tighter race, or a surge of outside spending against Salinas, would be the main signal to revisit.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Andrea Salinas seeks a second term in a district drawn to favor Democrats by about six points, and she enters the general election with the advantages of incumbency and a dominant financial position. She has raised roughly $1.6 million and holds over $600,000 on hand, while Republican David Russ has raised about $13,000 with minimal cash remaining and no visible outside support.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and the fundraising gap, both of which point clearly to Salinas. Prediction markets price her win at roughly 96%, consistent with a comfortable but not guaranteed margin.
